title: A Year Of Vibes
summary: Armin Ronacher reflects on a year of hands-off agentic coding and argues version control, code review and observability need rethinking for AI-generated code.

assertions.quote: I wish I could see the prompts that led to changes.
It’s not just GitHub, it’s also git that is lacking.
Discarding the paths that led you astray means that the model will try the same mistakes again.
I find reading such pull requests quite rage-inducing.
I still treat it like regular software engineering and review a lot.
I have nothing beyond vibes to back up my preference for Claude.
AI has the potential to encourage building on fewer dependencies

verdicts.note: Cheap generation lowers build costs, but maintenance and security burden still favor many dependencies, and the trend is not yet measured.

assertions.quote: The better the feedback loop to the machine, the better the results.
